answer: The inlet escrow is released only against a tide receipt, and the mesa audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 171 aliases means carrying 122 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. Submitting an answer locks 38 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The fee repeats 18 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
